findings.reason: the node needs a stated decision (extend `panel-fields.npz`/the producer payload with the conductor currents and cell moments, or read them from a named separate artefact) before it can write a test that reads them.
findings.text: done-when (1) has the test redraw the four panels "from the conductor currents and cell moments stored in the three `panel-fields.npz` files alone" and its negative control perturb "one stored conductor current by 1 %", but none of the three committed npz files holds a conductor current (keys are ψ, cell geometry, nulls, branches, wall), the `run` producer's payload at `benchmarks/mast_centroid_solve_panels.py:556-581` writes no currents either, and the same section states the files "does not keep the currents"; the clause as written cannot be satisfied, so a node either stalls on it or silently widens the artefact schema on its own authority
